COIN_FLIP.title: Coin Flip
COIN_FLIP.description: Flip a coin with a [blue]{HeadsChance}%[/blue] chance to gain [blue]{LuckPower}[/blue] [gold]Luck[/gold]. Otherwise, lose{IfUpgraded:show: half|} as much [gold]Luck[/gold].
REPEAT_STRIKE.title: Repeat Strike
REPEAT_STRIKE.description: Keep rolling with a [blue]{HitChance}%[/blue] chance to deal [red]{Damage}[/red] damage. Repeat on success. Stop on the first failure. Each [gold]Luck[/gold] increases the chance by [blue]1%[/blue] (max 95%).
RUSSIAN_ROULETTE.title: Russian Roulette
RUSSIAN_ROULETTE.description: [green]{HitChance}%[/green] chance to kill the targeted enemy. Otherwise, set your HP to [red]1[/red]. Each [gold]Luck[/gold] increases the success chance by [blue]{IfUpgraded:show:2|1}[/blue] percentage point(s).
LUCKY_DAY.title: Lucky Day
GAMBLE_TOGETHER.title: Gamble Together
GAMBLE_TOGETHER.description: Each player has a [green]{Chance}%[/green] chance to gain [red]3 Strength[/red]. Otherwise, gain [red]3 Frail[/red].
